raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
(cherry picked from commit 5a1f509bc2e822d1bc682bc5b83e462926966530)

- GPT-OSS-20B BF16/FP8: align with the tuned MI300X configs (#1329):
  Primus-Turbo grouped GEMM (hipBLASLt backend), Turbo RMSNorm and
  norm+TE linear, DeepEP, sync-free MoE stage 2, gradient accumulation
  fusion, fp32 router, micro batch size 8 -> 4.
- ZAYA1-8B BF16: micro batch size 216 -> 184 and global batch size
  1728 -> 1472 (one micro batch per GPU per step at DP=8) to prevent OOM.

<!-- pr-pundit-live:primus-1355-53b83618 -->
### PR Pundit review
9 findings, 4 as comments on the diff below.

| # | | Finding | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 🟠 | MI325X GPT-OSS-20B FP8 re-enables delayed-scaling patches that memory-faulted: this PR dropped the guard | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-FP8-pretrain.yaml:108` ↓ |
| 2 | 🟠 | MI325X GPT-OSS-20B trains without learned attention sinks: this PR dropped `use_sink_attention: true` | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:80` ↓ |
| 3 | 🟠 | Exported PRIMUS_TEAM/USER/EXP_NAME ignored for MI325X GPT-OSS runs: this PR switched to TEAM/USER/EXP_NAME | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:1` ↓ |
| 4 | 🟠 | MI325X GPT-OSS runs log to the DeepSeek W&B project: this PR copied MI300X `wandb_project` | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:15` ↓ |
| 5 | 🟠 | ZAYA1-8B BF16 comment still claims 216 is the max batch: this PR lowered it to 184 | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/zaya1_8B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:23` |
| 6 | 🔵 | MI325X GPT-OSS configs justify settings with MI300X measurements: this PR copied comments verbatim | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:84` |
| 7 | 🔵 | Sync-free MoE stage 2 silently implies fusion and DeepEP flags not visible in the yaml | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:99` |
| 8 | 🔵 | MI325X GPT-OSS tuning (micro batch 8→4, Turbo/DeepEP) lacks before/after throughput numbers | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:31` |
| 9 | 🔵 | `gradient_accumulation_fusion` enabled with `overlap_grad_reduce` without an MI325X justification | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:53` |

#### 5. 🟠 Should fix: ZAYA1-8B BF16 comment still claims 216 is the max batch: this PR lowered it to 184
`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/zaya1_8B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:23`

This PR lowers `micro_batch_size`/`global_batch_size` from 216/1728 to 184/1472. The comment above them still says 216 is the largest multiple of 8 that completes on MI325X (peaks at 249 of 256 GB; 224 OOMs). The comment now contradicts the configured value. Update it to describe 184 and its memory peak, as the FP8 sibling `zaya1_8B-FP8-pretrain.yaml` already does.

**Who is affected:** Readers or tuners of the MI325X ZAYA1-8B BF16 example config; training behaviour is unaffected.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

<details><summary>Nits and less certain findings (4)</summary>

**6. MI325X GPT-OSS configs justify settings with MI300X measurements: this PR copied comments verbatim** (`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:84`)

The new MI325X `gpt_oss_20B` BF16 and FP8 configs are byte-identical copies of the MI300X ones from a87a016 (#1332). They keep MI300X-specific comments: 'the default Triton grouped GEMM is slower on MI300X', '160 for ep8 on MI300X', and 'stage 3 itself OOMs on MI300X'. That makes it unclear whether `turbo_grouped_gemm_backend: hipblaslt`, `turbo_deepep_num_cu: 160` and sync-free stage 2 were validated on MI325X. Give the MI325X rationale or make the comments arch-neutral. In the FP8 file, `moe_shared_expert_overlap`/`moe_router_dtype` also ended up under the `# enable fp8 training` header.

**Who is affected:** Readers and tuners of the MI325X GPT-OSS-20B example configs; runtime behaviour is unaffected.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#1088](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1088) on `tests/unit_tests/backends/torchtitan/test_deepseek_v3_turbo_attention.py`, [#982](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/982) on `examples/mlperf/gpt_oss_20b/configs/MI355/gpt_oss_20B-MXFP4-deosc-mlperf-pretrain.yaml`

**7. Sync-free MoE stage 2 silently implies fusion and DeepEP flags not visible in the yaml** (`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:99`)

`turbo_sync_free_moe_stage: 2` makes `_get_sync_free_moe_options` overwrite `moe_use_fused_router_with_aux_score`, `moe_permute_fusion` and `use_turbo_deepep` with `True`. The explicit `use_turbo_deepep: true` is therefore redundant, and the old `false` overrides would have been ignored anyway. `use_turbo_grouped_gemm: true` is not redundant: `validate_args_on_rocm` raises `ValueError` for stage 2/3 unless it is set before the auto-enable runs. The forced values are logged at startup, not applied silently. An optional comment next to the stage setting could note which flags it implies.

**Who is affected:** Readers editing the MI325X GPT-OSS-20B BF16/FP8 pretrain configs; runtime behaviour is unaffected.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#220](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/220) on `tests/trainer/test_megatron_trainer.py`

**8. MI325X GPT-OSS tuning (micro batch 8→4, Turbo/DeepEP) lacks before/after throughput numbers** (`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:31`)

`micro_batch_size` is halved (8→4) at GBS 640, doubling accumulation steps, while many Turbo features and DeepEP with `num_cu=160` are enabled. `moe_permute_fusion` now silently comes from `deepseek_v2_base.yaml` (true). The PR has no MI325X throughput or memory numbers; include before/after results.

_An independent check of the code found this probably does not apply: `turbo_sync_free_moe_stage: 2` makes `rocm_arg_validation._get_sync_free_moe_options` `setattr` `moe_permute_fusion=True`, `moe_use_fused_router_with_aux_score=True`, `use_turbo_deepep` and `use_turbo_grouped_gemm` on the args, so the dropped overrides would be forced regardless of the `deepseek_v2_base.yaml` value. The new MI325X files are byte-identical to the MI300X configs from #1332, so the `micro_batch_size` 8->4 change is a deliberate tuning choice, and a request for benchmark numbers is …_

**9. `gradient_accumulation_fusion` enabled with `overlap_grad_reduce` without an MI325X justification** (`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:53`)

`gradient_accumulation_fusion` flips to true while `overlap_grad_reduce`/`overlap_param_gather` stay true, in both GPT-OSS configs. This combination previously caused perf/compatibility issues, and no MI325X justification is given. Document why it is safe or keep it false.

_An independent check of the code found this probably does not apply: At base, examples/megatron/configs/MI300X/gpt_oss_20B-{BF16,FP8}-pretrain.yaml already set `gradient_accumulation_fusion: true` together with `overlap_grad_reduce`/`overlap_param_gather: true` (#1332), and primus/configs/models/megatron/language_model.yaml defaults the flag to true. `_fuse_wgrad_accum_pattern` in primus_turbo.py falls back safely for recipes without a fused wgrad epilogue, and the classes that reject the flag (`Float8*ParallelLinear`, the MXFP4 local classes) are only used by th…_

**Related past reviews:** [#145](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/145) on `examples/megatron/configs/deepseek_v2-pretrain.yaml`

</details>

**1. 🟠 Should fix: MI325X GPT-OSS-20B FP8 re-enables delayed-scaling patches that memory-faulted: this PR dropped the guard**

The MI325X `gpt_oss_20B-FP8-pretrain.yaml` is now a verbatim copy of the MI300X config. It silently drops `disable_delayed_scaling_patches: true` (and the explicit `fp8_recipe: delayed`), a guard #900 added for MI325X because the delayed-scaling stream patches hit a GPU memory fault (`sum_and_scatter`) at about iter 6. With `fp8: hybrid` and the `trainer_base.yaml` default `fp8_recipe: delayed`, `_needs_delayed_scaling` now returns True, so `megatron.fp8.delayed_scaling_update` and the prefetch patch are re-enabled on MI325X. The other MI325X FP8 configs (llama3.1/3.3, qwen3_30B_A3B) keep the guard. Either keep `disable_delayed_scaling_patches: true` (or use `fp8_recipe: tensorwise`), or state in the PR that the fault no longer reproduces.

**Who is affected:** Users running the MI325X GPT-OSS-20B FP8 pretrain example.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**2. 🟠 Should fix: MI325X GPT-OSS-20B trains without learned attention sinks: this PR dropped `use_sink_attention: true`**

Both MI325X GPT-OSS-20B configs (BF16 and FP8) drop `use_sink_attention: true` because they are replaced wholesale by copies of the MI300X configs, which never enabled sinks. With the `primus_turbo.yaml` default `use_sink_attention: false`, these examples now train GPT-OSS without learned attention sinks. That is a model change in a perf-tuning PR, and the MI355X 20B configs still enable sinks (window 128). The old MI325X config already had `sink_sliding_window: 0`, so only the sinks themselves are lost. Restore `use_sink_attention: true`, or state that dropping it is intentional for parity with MI300X.

**Who is affected:** Users and the `tools/perf` jobs running `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-{BF16,FP8}-pretrain.yaml`.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**3. 🟠 Should fix: Exported PRIMUS_TEAM/USER/EXP_NAME ignored for MI325X GPT-OSS runs: this PR switched to TEAM/USER/EXP_NAME**

`work_group`/`user_name`/`exp_name` now read `TEAM`/`USER`/`EXP_NAME` instead of `PRIMUS_*`, breaking the convention used by the other MI325X configs and silently ignoring existing `PRIMUS_*` exports. `$USER` is almost always set, so the `root` default never applies. The default exp_name also loses its `-pretrain` suffix, which moves output directories. Restore the `PRIMUS_*` variables.

**Who is affected:** Anyone launching the MI325X GPT-OSS-20B BF16/FP8 example configs who sets PRIMUS_TEAM/PRIMUS_USER/PRIMUS_EXP_NAME (documented vars, e.g. exported by run_odc.sh) or relies on the default output path.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#440](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/440) on `examples/run_pretrain.sh`

**4. 🟠 Should fix: MI325X GPT-OSS runs log to the DeepSeek W&B project: this PR copied MI300X `wandb_project`**

Both MI325X GPT-OSS-20B configs now set `wandb_project: "Primus_DeepSeek_Pretrain"` instead of `Primus_GPT_OSS_20B_Pretrain`. The name comes from the MI300X GPT-OSS configs (#1332), which already use it, as do most Llama/Mixtral configs. W&B is off by default (`disable_wandb: true`), so this only mislabels runs when W&B is enabled. Consider restoring the GPT-OSS project name, as MI355X keeps.

**Who is affected:** Users who enable W&B (`disable_wandb: false`) when running the MI325X GPT-OSS-20B BF16/FP8 pretrain examples.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**2. 🟠 Should fix: MI325X GPT-OSS-20B trains without learned attention sinks: this PR dropped `use_sink_attention: true`**

Both MI325X GPT-OSS-20B configs (BF16 and FP8) drop `use_sink_attention: true` because they are replaced wholesale by copies of the MI300X configs, which never enabled sinks. With the `primus_turbo.yaml` default `use_sink_attention: false`, these examples now train GPT-OSS without learned attention sinks. That is a model change in a perf-tuning PR, and the MI355X 20B configs still enable sinks (window 128). The old MI325X config already had `sink_sliding_window: 0`, so only the sinks themselves are lost. Restore `use_sink_attention: true`, or state that dropping it is intentional for parity with MI300X.

**Who is affected:** Users and the `tools/perf` jobs running `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-{BF16,FP8}-pretrain.yaml`.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**3. 🟠 Should fix: Exported PRIMUS_TEAM/USER/EXP_NAME ignored for MI325X GPT-OSS runs: this PR switched to TEAM/USER/EXP_NAME**

`work_group`/`user_name`/`exp_name` now read `TEAM`/`USER`/`EXP_NAME` instead of `PRIMUS_*`, breaking the convention used by the other MI325X configs and silently ignoring existing `PRIMUS_*` exports. `$USER` is almost always set, so the `root` default never applies. The default exp_name also loses its `-pretrain` suffix, which moves output directories. Restore the `PRIMUS_*` variables.

**Who is affected:** Anyone launching the MI325X GPT-OSS-20B BF16/FP8 example configs who sets PRIMUS_TEAM/PRIMUS_USER/PRIMUS_EXP_NAME (documented vars, e.g. exported by run_odc.sh) or relies on the default output path.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#440](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/440) on `examples/run_pretrain.sh`

**4. 🟠 Should fix: MI325X GPT-OSS runs log to the DeepSeek W&B project: this PR copied MI300X `wandb_project`**

Both MI325X GPT-OSS-20B configs now set `wandb_project: "Primus_DeepSeek_Pretrain"` instead of `Primus_GPT_OSS_20B_Pretrain`. The name comes from the MI300X GPT-OSS configs (#1332), which already use it, as do most Llama/Mixtral configs. W&B is off by default (`disable_wandb: true`), so this only mislabels runs when W&B is enabled. Consider restoring the GPT-OSS project name, as MI355X keeps.

**Who is affected:** Users who enable W&B (`disable_wandb: false`) when running the MI325X GPT-OSS-20B BF16/FP8 pretrain examples.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._
